sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports the type and icons
sections.what: Brings in the industry type and two icons used on the card.
sections.why: Likely reason: the card needs the industry shape and icons to draw itself.

sections.name: DatumIndustryTileProps
sections.title: What the card needs from its parent
sections.what: Lists the inputs: the industry, its list position, whether it is selected, the optional project count, an optional loading flag and the toggle function.
sections.why: Likely reason: the parent handles selection and counting so the card stays simple.
sections.watch_out: The count is optional, so a parent that forgets to pass it leaves a dash on the card.

sections.name: DatumIndustryTile (part 1)
sections.title: Greyed card for unfinished industries
sections.what: Shows a non-clickable card with the industry name, tagline, a Coming soon badge and a short description. It fades in with a small delay based on its position in the list.
sections.why: Likely reason: the list stays complete while preventing selection of an unfinished industry.
sections.watch_out: This card is not a button, so keyboard users cannot reach it. It is informational only.

sections.name: DatumIndustryTile (part 2)
sections.title: Selectable card for live industries
sections.what: Shows a clickable card with a check mark that fills when chosen, a Live marker and the project count. A selected card gets a coloured border and ring.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code for the exact styling choices.
sections.watch_out: While the count loads the card shows three dots, and without any count it shows a dash, so the two states look different.

summary: A card on the industries page for one industry. Live industries show a selectable tile with a project count, and unfinished ones show a greyed Coming soon tile.
purpose: Lets someone choose which industries to include and shows how many projects each one has.
why: Likely reason: unfinished industries should be visible but not selectable.
how: 1. Checks whether the industry is live. 2. If not, shows a greyed, non-clickable card with a Coming soon badge. 3. If live, shows a button with the name, tagline, description, a check mark and the project count. 4. Clicking the button sends the industry's slug to the parent.
inputs: The industry record, its position in the list, whether it is selected, the project count, a loading flag and the toggle function.
outputs: One card on screen. Clicking a live card calls the toggle function with its slug.
risks: When no count is given, the card shows a dash, which can look like missing data.
debug: If a tile looks wrong, check the industry status value (it must be LIVE to be selectable). If the count is missing, check the loading flag and the count prop. If selection does not show, check the selected prop from the parent.
